comment: Read at commit 3d836d1, the commit that bumped plugin.json to the installed 2.4.2; the only later commit on the repository, b0725bd, adds a diagram to the README and changes no code. The maker's README calls the big knob Time and describes a Time modulation input, but commit 7967e07 renamed the parameter to speed and the panel prints Tape Speed, with the modulation jack printed Speed and its attenuator printed Amount. The README also says the insert return goes after the delay line and before the mix, which the code bears out: the Return jack substitutes for the tape output entirely rather than being added to it. The Out jack carries the input plus the delayed signal scaled by Feedback, so Feedback doubles as the wet level and the output is dry when it is at zero; the README's signal diagram shows this and the panel does not. The 50-sample offset between the write and read points in the buffer is left out of the lines, being too small to hear. The tape length is saved with the patch.
